svg.text: SLDS spacing tokens · 4px grid · Compact + Comfortable density · Responsive breakpoints · IBX / AmeriHealth color modes
Bind each as a Figma Number Variable in collection spacing/*. Bars drawn to scale; every value is a 4-multiple (2px hairline is the only ½).
Heading: Alright Sans → Arial. Body: Arial. Line-heights are 4px multiples.
Components reference semantic names only. Mode swap re-skins the whole library.
Compact = drop every spacing token one step + control heights −4px. Table rows use the fixed 44 / 32 pair.
Lightning/SLDS breakpoints. Draw one frame per width; key behaviors annotated.

g.text: cols: 4 → 6 → 8 → 12 → 12 density: Compact forced ≤ medium · Comfortable + toggle ≥ large touch target ≥ 44px ≤ small
